# Dev Agora — Discussion categories (GitHub-native)

Maintainer enables these in repo Settings → Discussions:

1. **Q&A** — implementation questions
2. **Skill Recipes** — verified multi-step recipes
3. **Show & Tell** — demos
4. **Ideas / RFCs** — proposals (Phase 2 announcement draft lives in docs/GITHUB_DISCUSSION_DRAFT.md)
5. **Compatibility Reports** — matrix evidence
6. **Agent Interoperability** — Cursor/Claude/Grok adapters

Flywheel: answer → verified recipe → candidate skill → validation → reviewed skill → release
